resources.string:
For best reliability:

1. Tap "Set as default SMS app" — this lets the app receive SMS_DELIVER, which cannot be aborted by other apps (the main reason bank/OTP SMS are dropped by other forwarders).
2. Tap "Grant runtime permissions" and accept all prompts.
3. Tap "Disable battery optimization" and choose "Allow".
4. Enter the destination number with country code (e.g. +911234567890) and tap Save.

No sender filter is applied by default — every incoming SMS is forwarded.
